tools.name: agent_get_state
tools.title: Get MCMCP State
tools.description: Returns the latest immutable, policy-filtered client state and the latest observation-frame summary. It never scans hidden world data.

ready_expires_at.description: Schema v1 compatibility field; always null because READY does not expire

tools.name: agent_get_observation
tools.title: Get MCMCP Observation
tools.description: Returns a stable, paged view of one policy-filtered omnidirectional observation frame. It accepts no arbitrary center or radius.

tools.name: agent_start_action
tools.title: Start MCMCP Action
tools.description: Queues one validated and statically bounded Action DSL v1 program after the in-game MCP operation button is enabled.

openPassageNode.description: Open one currently visible allowlisted wooden door, trapdoor, or fence gate. A door succeeds only after both halves are authoritatively open.

inspectContainerNode.description: Open one visible in-reach single chest/barrel and return up to 27 server-synchronized item counts in NODE_EVIDENCE. Reserve at least 400 ticks, 20000 ms, 180 camera degrees, and 1 interaction.

takeContainerStackNode.description: Move at most one whole matching stack from one visible in-reach single chest/barrel, then close/reopen it for full server readback. Reserve at least 400 ticks, 20000 ms, 180 camera degrees, and 3 interactions.

tools.name: agent_get_action
tools.title: Get MCMCP Action
tools.description: Returns bounded progress and a policy-filtered trace for one explicit action handle.

tools.name: agent_cancel_action
tools.title: Cancel MCMCP Action
tools.description: Idempotently requests cancellation of one explicit action handle.
